title: Full complex Boolean Holant dichotomy (D)
fixed_parameters: For evaluation and hardness: valid exact finite Boolean language L, original graph label layout, ordinary or native-X wiring. Machine and polynomial depend on L. For recognition: a single ordinary and a single native finite machine precede all valid runtime descriptor lists.
runtime_inputs: Evaluation receives validated original RawClosedNetwork bytes. Recognition receives all finite exact algebraic table entries, arities and language size as RawLanguage.
input_promises: Each table has 2^arity entries, every exact RootCode is valid; arbitrary mixed finite arities, zero and nullary signatures allowed. Graph preserves ordered ports, loops, parallel edges, isolated nullary vertices. Recognition only asserts halting/correctness for raw.Valid.
outputs: Evaluation returns RootCode.MinimalRepresents: strict monic irreducible rational minimal polynomial and rational isolating rectangle; descriptors need not be unique. Recognition returns Boolean with actual finite halting run.
auxiliary_resources: Ordinary equality edge kernel or native-X disequality edge kernel. No implicit pinning, arbitrary unary, equality-vertex label or infinite resource family. Native criterion is Tract(kImage L), while the evaluated graph language remains L.
reduction_direction_and_type: Every natural-valued source f satisfying original InSharpP reduces to the L evaluation problem, for every bounded correct public answer convention, through LengthControlledOracleReduction. BoundedAnswers is explicitly nonempty.
cost: Fixed-language polynomial finite TM2 graph-bit evaluator; hardness contains target output-length and safe-query polynomial bounds. Basic oracle reply delivery is one abstract oracle transition; concrete inlining separately charges callee time, copying, old-answer clearing and protocol work. No uniform polynomial recognition bound.
limits: Boolean-domain ordinary-graph classification. Structural branches are exclusive; no unconditional FP/#P-hard separation, arbitrary-domain classification, planar hardness, or natural-valued #P membership for complex evaluation.
acceptance: Named endpoints are present in historical INT9 all audit; full current type extraction is separately recorded per declaration. H1 independent staging is historical and does not assign acceptance to its 926 unreachable originals.

input_promises: Original ordered ports and graph occurrences preserved. Zero/nullary signatures remain. Theorem 1.2 assumes literal binary equality member; 1.3 assumes an actual arity-4 member q with odd Hamming-weight entries zero, q(0000)*q(1111) nonzero, and TensorPrime q.
outputs: Evaluation uses OriginalFamily.presentation(...).encoding in a fixed family field with rational coordinates. Recognition uses the original output packet and exact TM2OutputsInTime clock.
auxiliary_resources: 1.1: equality edges, explicitly added X vertex label; criterion TractX(K(F union {I})). 1.2: native X edges, literal I member in F, criterion TractX(K(F)). 1.3: native X edges and given quaternary member, criterion Tract(K(F)); no I added. 2.19: equality edges and Tract(F).
reduction_direction_and_type: Original natural-valued witness counting sources reduce to the specified family-field value through WitnessCountingHard and original polynomial-time oracle reduction; do not replace it with D's stronger strict-root length-controlled public contract or F1 parsimonious reduction.

input_promises: Positive arity for every language symbol. Recognition/structural-collapse use nonempty domain. Direct ordinary_jointBO classification allows empty D; ordinary_conditions requires Nonempty D. Degree evaluator/recognizer/classification requires 0<delta; degree_structural_collapse equivalence itself has no positivity premise. Degree promise counts literal occurrence multiplicities and requires each variable degree divisible by delta.

title: Qutrit support trichotomy and unbounded exact matchgate width
fixed_parameters: Each theorem quantifies mathematical common presentations/labelled languages and instance classes, not a machine language to evaluate. Qutrit trichotomy fixes domain Fin 3 and a common presentation with baseMatrix rank 3, both left/right port deficiency and both left/right support essentiality.
runtime_inputs: No runtime machine input in headline support/width propositions. Ordered planar labelled instance classes and presentations are the quantified mathematical objects.
input_promises: Unbounded-family claims require ContainsOrderedPlanar(C k), k>=2, rational coefficient and graph presentations, and the displayed IntegerPositiveDeficient hypotheses. Width minimization compares exact equivalent presentations preserving labels, arities and port order, with arbitrary finite nonempty alternative domains and complex weights.
outputs: Support trichotomy: exactly one ray/mobile/flag alternative under stated premises. Integer family: attained minimum exact common width, explicit lower/upper bounds and Omega(2^(k/2)/k) growth. Other endpoints give field-preserving graph realization and specified compression/equivalence witnesses.
auxiliary_resources: Exact labelled common presentation and ordered planar realization assumptions remain. A flag branch alone is not a characterization of minimum width; unboundedness is a separately quantified family theorem.
reduction_direction_and_type: No complexity reduction in the headline width/support statements. Compression and exact label-preserving equivalence are semantic/algebraic conclusions, not an automatic #P or FP transfer.
cost: Explicit width/size and asymptotic bounds as displayed; no polynomial bit-time machine theorem in these headline aliases. Exact field-preserving realization is separate from executable coefficient encoding.
limits: Support geometry and representation limits, not arbitrary-domain Holant classification or complexity-class separation. Connection-prime collapse 10.7 has its own assumptions (right essentiality, connection-prime) and must not inherit the trichotomy's premise list blindly.
